'''Helder Spinoza''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] member of the [[Bespin Wing Guard]] in [[Cloud City]] on the [[gas giant]] [[Bespin]]. When the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] arrived in Cloud City in [[3 ABY]], Spinoza was among the guards who accompanied Cloud City's [[Baron Administrator]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] onto [[Platform 327]] in order to greet him.

After Calrissian turned Solo over to the [[Galactic Empire]] as part of a deal, the Baron Administrator decided to turn on the Empire and save Solo's allies from Imperial custody. He had his [[aide]] [[Lobot]] lead Spinoza and several other guards in ambushing and capturing the Imperials escorting Solo's allies, freeing the prisoners and taking the Imperials to Cloud City's [[security tower]].

==Biography==
===Platform greeting===
{{Quote|How you doin', you old pirate? So good to see you!|Lando Calrissian greets Solo as a friend, causing Lobot to dismiss Spinoza and the other guards|<ref name="ESB" />}}
[[File:Lando13.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Helder Spinoza accompanied Lando Calrissian to Platform 327.]]
Helder Spinoza<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Vintage Collection|pack=#233: Bespin Security Guard (Helder Spinoza)|altlink=https://galacticfigures.com/NewsDetails?id=34083}}</ref> was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a member<ref name="ESB" /> of the [[Bespin Wing Guard]]<ref name="USWNE">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> of [[Cloud City]] on the [[gas giant]] [[Bespin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="ESB" /> In [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of {{Film|V}} to [[3 ABY]].</ref> the Empire arrived on Bespin and forced [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]], the [[Baron Administrator]] of Cloud City, to agree to a deal in which he would aid the Empire in capturing his old friend [[Han Solo]], a [[smuggler]] working with the Alliance.<ref name="ESB" />

Solo and a group of his allies soon arrived in Cloud City in the [[YT-1300 light freighter]] known as the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' and were directed to land on [[Platform 327]]. Spinoza and five other guards accompanied Calrissian and his [[aide]] [[Lobot]] out onto the platform to greet the new arrivals, which also included [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], [[Chewbacca]], and the [[protocol droid]] [[C-3PO]]. Initially the Baron Administrator greeted Solo in a hostile manner, but then laughed and embraced his old acquaintance, after which Lobot dismissed Spinoza and the other guards, causing them to march from the platform back inside the [[city]].<ref name="ESB" />

===Ambushing Imperials===
{{Quote|Well done.|Lando Calrissian congratulates Spinoza and the others on their ambush|<ref name="ESB" />}}
After being led into a trap by Calrissian, Solo and his allies were captured by the Empire and the smuggler was frozen in [[carbonite]]. Calrissian was then ordered to deliver Organa and Chewbacca to the [[starship]] of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], and escorted them with four [[stormtrooper]]s and<ref name="ESB" /> Imperial [[Lieutenant]] [[Sheckil]].<ref name="Sheckil">{{ForceCollection|Lieutenant Sheckil|star=1}}</ref> However, the Baron Administrator had decided to renegade on his deal with the Empire and aid the Alliance, contacting Lobot, who gathered Spinoza and several other guards.<ref name="ESB" />

[[File:HelderSpinozaAmbush-TESB.png|thumb|300px|right|Led by Lobot, Spinoza and other Wing Guard ambushed the Imperials.]]
Spinoza, Lobot, and the other guards then ambushed Sheckil and the troopers in one of Cloud City's corridors and forced them to surrender at [[blaster]]-point. Calrissian gave orders for the Imperials to be quietly kept in the [[security tower]], and Spinoza and the other guards then escorted the Imperials away<ref name="ESB" /> to a holding cell,<ref name="SYWtbaJ">''[[The Empire Strikes Back: So You Want to Be a Jedi?]]''</ref> leaving Organa, Chewbacca, and C-3PO with Calrissian. Due to Calrissian's betrayal, the Empire took control of Cloud City, and the Baron Administer issued one final warning to its citizens telling them to leave before he fled himself with his new rebel allies.<ref name="ESB" />

==Personality and traits==
Helder Spinoza had light skin and [[Color|black]] [[hair]].<ref name="ESB" />

==Equipment==
Spinoza wore the gold-trimmed blue [[Clothing|uniform]] of the Wing Guard, including a [[Hat|cap]], red bracers,<ref name="ESB" /> a black [[holster]], and black [[boot]]s.<ref name="Hasbro" /> He used a [[Relby K-23 blaster pistol]].<ref name="ESB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Helder Spinoza first appeared in the [[1980]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="ESB" /> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Spinoza was first identified on an [[2022]] action figure released as part of the ''[[Star Wars Vintage Collection]]'' produced by [[Hasbro]].<ref name="Hasbro" /> The named originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity,<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|148|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Cloud City Wing Guards}}</ref> where it was created by [[Tim Veekhoven]]<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|Sompeetalay|status/1504214804797526019|[[Tim Veekhoven]]|quote=It seems I named a Star Wars action figure! Helder Spinoza was named by myself in 2014 for the Rogues Gallery feature for Star Wars Insider on which I worked on with @Whiphid and Sander De Lange. Another thing to scratch from the bucket list ! 😉|archivedate=20220316235143}}</ref> for "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery: The Cloud City Wing Guards"]], an article published in [[Star Wars Insider 148|''Star Wars Insider'' 148]]<ref name="Insider" /> on [[March 11]], [[2014]].<ref name="Titan">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/148|text=Star Wars Insider Issue #148}}</ref>

''[[The Empire Strikes Back: So You Want to Be a Jedi?]]'', a [[2015]] adaptation of Episode V written by [[Adam Gidwitz]], erroneously describes a dozen Wing Guards accompanying Calrissian onto Platform 327 rather then just six,<ref name="SYWtbaJ" /> as shown in the film.<ref name="ESB" /> It also describes the Wings Guards that free Organa, Chewbacca, and C-3PO as a [[platoon]] who were already traveling with Calrissian and the Imperials rather than arriving with Lobot,<ref name="SYWtbaJ" /> contradicting the events of the film again.<ref name="ESB" />
